steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Dance reflects the society in which it is created, responding to political, economic and social conditions | Key Fact: Cultural traditions shape dance vocabulary, from Bharatanatyam's Hindu storytelling to Flamenco's Romani heritage | Key Fact: Technology has expanded dance through lighting, projection, digital music and motion capture | Key Fact: Gender roles in dance have evolved — from male-only court ballet to challenging stereotypes in contemporary work

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from social &amp; cultural influences on dance, and one past-paper question.
